| Concept | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Signal analysis and standardization](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Analyse a machine's signals and standardize them so a second plant can consume them without asking a question. Reads the machine context (PLC program, tag export, sequence chart, handbook, HMI) to establish how it works, inventories the data points an edge platform exposes, checks them against the canonical vocabulary and against what a capability actually requires, finds the name collisions, raw PLC tags and coverage gaps that stop a use case being built, and takes the result through the data-model decision. Use when a machine is newly connected and its signals need naming, when a use case cannot be built because a signal is missing or ambiguous, when two plants' versions of the same signal will not compare, or before publishing any derived data point. Adopts public data models (OPC UA for Machinery, EUROMAP, PackML) instead of re-inventing them; output is a signal analysis report. Not for connecting the machine (od-equipment-integration) or building flows (od-node-red-flow-builder). |
